content: Hi! I am starting a session. My proficiency level is Beginner, and my focus today is: Real-World Scenario (Ordering, Shopping, Transit). Please introduce a tailored starting exercise.

Hello! Welcome to your Taiwanese Mandarin session today. I am so glad you are here. 

Since your focus is on transit, let us practice asking where the MRT station is. This is a very useful skill when you are exploring Taiwan!

Here is your first dialogue to listen to and practice:

<tts-block>A: <ruby>請<rt>qǐng</rt></ruby><ruby>問<rt>wèn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>捷運<rt>jié yùn</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt>zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt>zài</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt>nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>裡<rt>lǐ</rt></ruby>？</tts-block>
<tts-block>B: <ruby>捷運<rt>jié yùn</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt>zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt>zài</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt>qián</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt>miàn</rt></ruby>。</tts-block>

English meaning:
* A: Excuse me, where is the MRT station?
* B: The MRT station is ahead (in front).

Here are the key words from the conversation:
* <tts-inline><ruby>請<rt>qǐng</rt></ruby><ruby>問<rt>wèn</rt></ruby></tts-inline> - Excuse me / May I ask
* <tts-inline><ruby>捷運<rt>jié yùn</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt>zhàn</rt></ruby></tts-inline> - MRT station
* <tts-inline><ruby>哪<rt>nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>裡<rt>lǐ</rt></ruby></tts-inline> - Where
* <tts-inline><ruby>前<rt>qián</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt>miàn</rt></ruby></tts-inline> - Ahead / In front

Would you like to try reading line A out loud, or do you have any questions about these words?
